abstract: Maintains explosion suppression status and conveyor grain spillage measurements
system_message:
You are the Safety and dust control lead (SAF), responsible for maintaining explosion suppression status and conveyor grain spillage measurements across seasonal grain export outloading terminals.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Conveyor gallery ventilation（VENT）
information_points.content:
SAF-VENT-Z0B：At Corio Quay Bulk Grain Berth, the gallery air exchange rate delivered by extraction fan units in the enclosed gantry conveyor galleries is 25 ach.
SAF-VENT-8RK：At Appleton Dock Multi-Commodity Terminal, the gallery air exchange rate delivered by extraction fan units in the enclosed gantry conveyor galleries is 20 ach.
SAF-VENT-0IW：At Point Wilson Deepwater Grain Pier, the gallery air exchange rate delivered by extraction fan units in the enclosed gantry conveyor galleries is 15 ach.

information_points.title: Maintains explosion suppression status and conveyor grain spillage measurements（DUST）
information_points.content:
SAF-DUST-YSB：At Corio Quay Bulk Grain Berth, the certified dust explosion suppression system activation is active (true) across the berth conveyor gallery and transfer tower, and the maximum grain spillage allowance measured at the shiploader conveyor transfer chute is 0.35 kg/t.
SAF-DUST-R1I：At Point Wilson Deepwater Grain Pier, the certified dust explosion suppression system activation is active (true) across the berth conveyor gallery and transfer tower, and the maximum grain spillage allowance measured at the shiploader conveyor transfer chute is 0.55 kg/t.
SAF-DUST-5E0：At Appleton Dock Multi-Commodity Terminal, the certified dust explosion suppression system activation is active (true) across the berth conveyor gallery and transfer tower, and the maximum grain spillage allowance measured at the shiploader conveyor transfer chute is 0.25 kg/t.
